# The Ice Hut

> Family-owned ice cream shop in Morinville, Alberta, Canada, serving premium Foothills Creamery ice cream since 1995. Known for 75+ rotating flavours, famously generous scoops, milkshakes, ice cream nachos, gluten-free options, and $2.25 Puppy Cones for dogs. Tagline: "Cold Treats & Other Eats."

## Key facts

- Address: 9911 100 Street, Morinville, Alberta, T8R 1R4, Canada (about 20 minutes north of Edmonton)
- Phone: (780) 974-9944
- Email: dawn@morinvilleicehut.ca
- Season: open May through September; closed October–April
- Hours May–June: Monday–Friday 3:00pm–9:30pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:30pm
- Hours July–August: every day 12:00pm–9:30pm
- Hours September: Monday–Friday 3:00pm–9:00pm; Saturday–Sunday 12:00pm–9:00pm
- Founded: 1995, family-owned and operated
- Ice cream: premium Foothills Creamery (made in Alberta), 75+ rotating flavours, including sorbets, sherbets, lactose-free and no-sugar-added options
- Popular flavours: Chocolate Peanut Butter, New York Cherry Cheesecake, Sea Salt Caramel Fudge, Tiger, All Canadian Moose, Haskap Prairie Berry, Saskatoon Pie
- Dietary: the flavour board tags each flavour that CONTAINS nuts, gluten or egg, and flags no-lactose / no-dairy options; gluten-free cones $1.50
- Contains nuts (12): All Canadian Moose, Belgian Hazelnut, Butter Pecan, Caramel Crunch NSA, Chocolate Peanut Butter, Funky Monkey, Kulfi, Maple Nut, Peanut Butter Crunch, Pistachio With Almonds, Rocky Road, Turtle Mountain
- Allergy caveat: an untagged flavour is NOT certified nut-free. All flavours share one freezer and shared scoops, so cross-contact is possible in any tub. Customers with a serious allergy should ask staff at the window.
- Dog-friendly: Puppy Cone available for $2.25
- Seating: grassy area with picnic benches on-site
- Payment: cash, credit card, debit card
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/morinvilleicehut/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/morinvilleicehut/

## Menu & pricing (CAD, before GST)

**Sizes**
- Puppy Cone (for dogs): $2.25
- Kids Single: $4.50
- Kids Double: $5.50
- Single: $6.50
- Double: $7.50
- Giant (3 flavours): $9.00
- Waffle cone or gluten-free cone upgrade: +$1.50

**Other eats**
- Ice Cream Nachos (shareable): $9.75
- Ice Cream Float: $8.50
- Milkshake, 24oz: $9.00
- Milkshake, 32oz: $11.00
- Sprinkles: +$0.50
- Crumble topping: +$1.00

**Drinks**
- Water: $2.00
- Bottled pop (Berry Lemonade, Coke, Cream Soda, Orange Cream, Rootbeer, Strawberry Lime, Iced Tea, Lemonade): $3.00

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Where is The Ice Hut located?
A: 9911 100 Street, Morinville, Alberta, T8R 1R4, about 20 minutes north of Edmonton.

Q: What are The Ice Hut's hours?
A: Seasonal, May through September. May–June: Mon–Fri 3–9:30pm, weekends 12–9:30pm. July–August: daily 12–9:30pm. September: Mon–Fri 3–9pm, weekends 12–9pm. Closed October–April.

Q: Does The Ice Hut have gluten-free options?
A: Yes. The flavour board tags every flavour containing gluten, and a gluten-free cone is available for $1.50. There are also dairy-free sorbets, lactose-free and no-sugar-added flavours. Everything is scooped from a shared freezer with shared scoops, so customers with a serious intolerance should tell staff.

Q: Which flavours contain nuts?
A: Twelve are tagged Contains Nuts: All Canadian Moose, Belgian Hazelnut, Butter Pecan, Caramel Crunch NSA, Chocolate Peanut Butter, Funky Monkey, Kulfi, Maple Nut, Peanut Butter Crunch, Pistachio With Almonds, Rocky Road, Turtle Mountain. A flavour without the tag is NOT certified nut-free: all tubs share one freezer and shared scoops, so cross-contact is possible. Anyone with a nut allergy should speak to staff at the window before ordering.

Q: Can I bring my dog?
A: Yes, a Puppy Cone made for dogs is $2.25.

Q: How much is a milkshake?
A: $9.00 for 24oz or $11.00 for 32oz, any flavour.

Q: Is there seating?
A: Yes, a grassy area with picnic benches on-site.

Q: How long has The Ice Hut been open?
A: Since 1995, over three decades, family-owned and operated throughout.

All Canadian Moose, Banana Chocolate Fudge, Banana Split, Belgian Hazelnut, Birthday Cake, Black Licorice, Blast Off, Blueberry Cheesecake, Bubble Gum, Burgundy Cherry, Butter Pecan, Campfire Smores, Caramel Candy Apple, Caramel Coffee Macchiato (No Sugar Added), Caramel Crunch (No Sugar Added), Cherry Custard, Chocolate, Chocolate Covered Strawberry, Chocolate Lactose-Free, Chocolate Peanut Butter, Cinnamon Bun, Coconut, Coffee Bean, Cookie Beast, Cookie Dough, Cookies & Cream, Cotton Candy, Cream Soda Float, Creme Brulee, Dunkamoo, Funky Monkey, Grape Float, Haskap Prairie Berry, Ice Cream Of Champions, Kulfi, Lemon Sorbet (Dairy-Free), Mango, Maple Nut, Mint Chocolate Chip, Mocha Mountain, Moon Mist, Mud Pie, Nanaimo Brownie, New York Cherry Cheesecake, Oh Canada, Orange Float, Passion Fruit Sorbet (Dairy-Free), Peanut Butter Crunch, Pineapple Sherbert, Pistachio With Almonds, Rainbow Sherbert, Raspberry Cheesecake, Red Velvet, Rocket Pop Sorbet (Dairy-Free), Rocky Road, Rootbeer Float, Rum Raisin, Salted Chocolate Caramel, Salted Cookies & Cream, Sangria Sorbet (Dairy-Free), Saskatoon Pie, Sea Salt Caramel Fudge, Shaft, Shark Attack, Spiced Hot Chocolate Churro, Spumoni Twist, Strawberry, Strawberry Sensation (Lactose-Free), Tiger, Toasted Coconut (Lactose-Free), Triple Fudge Brownie, Turtle Mountain, Vanilla, Wet Paint, Whisky Caramel.

Dietary tags above reflect only what's explicitly stated on the menu board. Allergen details vary by flavour — ask staff at the window for current info.
